form.name: Cost Plan Name
form.billingKindOneTimeHint: Charged once at subscription start. No further expenditures on this subscription.
form.billingKindRecurringHint: Billed every cycle. Continues until the subscription is deactivated.
form.billingKindContractHint: Fixed-term commitment with a defined end date. Can bill periodically within the term or as a single total at start.
form.billingKindUsageBasedHint: Charges are based on actual consumption (API calls, compute hours, metered usage). Expenditure generated from usage records.
form.billingKindAdHocHint: Operator-recorded charges with no fixed cycle. Each occurrence generates its own expenditure.
form.amountBasisPerCycleHint: Amount charged each billing cycle. Required for Recurring and Contract-with-cycle cost plans.
form.amountBasisTotalPackageHint: Single total amount charged across the full term. One expenditure covers the full commitment.
form.amountBasisDerivedFromLinesHint: Total computed automatically from the per-product SupplierProductCostPlan rows. Amount input is hidden when this is selected.
form.amountBasisPerOccurrenceHint: Amount charged per occurrence. Ad hoc only — each occurrence fires its own expenditure.
form.termOpenEndedHelp: Leave empty for open-ended / no expiration
form.supplierPlanInfo: The supplier plan this cost plan belongs to. Locked from the parent page.
form.scheduleInfo: The cost schedule (date range) this cost plan belongs to.
form.nameInfo: Optional — defaults to the supplier plan name when left blank.
form.descriptionInfo: Optional notes shown alongside the cost plan in detail views.
form.billingKindInfo: One-time = charged once. Recurring = billed every cycle. Fixed-term = recurring with an end date. Usage-based = metered consumption. Ad hoc = operator-recorded per-occurrence charges.
form.amountBasisInfo: Per cycle = amount charged each billing cycle. Total package = amount charged across the full term. Sum of items = derived from per-product lines. Per occurrence = amount charged per occurrence (ad hoc only).
form.amountInfo: Cost in the selected currency. For Sum of items, this is computed automatically.
form.currencyInfo: Currency applied to this cost plan. Must match the workspace base currency.
form.billingCycleInfo: How often the recurring charge is issued (e.g. every 1 month).
form.termInfo: How long the subscription lasts. Leave empty for open-ended / no expiration.
form.activeInfo: Inactive cost plans stay on record but are hidden from new subscriptions.
